basics.name: Phillip Chaffee
basics.label: Founding Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with ten years across voice AI, speech analytics and fintech. At Sela AI, builds the live-call runtime that AI voice agents run on (call transfer, the conversation engine, autoscaling) and the tooling the team's coding agents work in.

work.name: Sela AI
highlights: Lead the engineering team of about 10 day to day: make architecture calls, review code (about 1,000 merge requests so far), and set parts of the engineering process.

Designed and built warm transfer, where the AI agent calls loan officers, screens whoever answers, and joins them to the customer’s live call. Since September 2025 it has handled about 630,000 transfers for 71 companies, and about 70% connect.
Wrote the shared state-machine library that tracks each transfer, and moved live traffic to it behind a feature flag.

Built predictive autoscaling that forecasts call volume 15–20 minutes ahead from the outbound call schedule. The API’s always-on floor went from 80 pods to 20 by day and 3 overnight, and it now averages about 29.

Rebuilt the core of the conversation engine: a call-scoped runtime replaced seven copied state fields, and one tool-call ledger replaced eight stores. Parity checks caught one ordering bug at 10% rollout, and the ramp to 100% then ran with zero divergences.

Replaced a fixed 30-minute shutdown wait with draining that lets in-flight calls finish, cutting a full rollout from about 39 minutes to 14 with no dropped connections. Also removed two blocking calls (100–160ms and ~300ms) from the live-call path.
Built the end-to-end test suite that runs on every dev deploy, including transfer scenarios played by three AI agents.
Lead the team’s AI coding workflows. Created the shared context repository that 14 other engineers have contributed to, and wrote its agent workflows for research, planning and code review.

Wrote TLA+ specifications for four parts of the call engine (turn lifecycle, tool resolution, tool execution and ledger, transfer orchestration), model-checked with TLC, with tests that replay execution traces from the Python code against the specs. Draft, in review.
work.summary: Sela builds AI voice and SMS agents that call sales leads and hand interested callers to a human. Its agents complete more than 15 million calls a month. Contracted in 2024, then joined full-time in February 2025.

work.name: VoiceOps
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (promoted from Software Engineer in 2021)
highlights: Redesigned the transcription data pipeline, reducing cost by 90% and bringing cost per audio minute from $0.20 to $0.02.
Architected a call audio integration API and a microservice for text-audio alignment.
Implemented SAML SSO allowing customers to authenticate using their own identity provider. Used by 20% of clients.
Built a Mechanical Turk-style transcription marketplace supporting 10k+ daily users performing manual transcription, transcript quality grading, and annotation tagging tasks.
Built the customer-facing review platform for call center managers to view transcripts, review annotation labels, and provide coaching feedback.
Wrote a TypeScript SDK for the AssemblyAI API.
work.summary: Voice analytics startup. Built data collection platforms, the transcription pipeline and customer-facing review tools, then led engineering ceremonies and worked on new architecture as a senior engineer.

work.name: Chatham Financial
work.position: Software Engineer (promoted from Software Test Engineer in 2017)
highlights: Built a .NET Core authentication microservice replacing a legacy library, supporting 10k+ requests/sec across all web applications.
Implemented SAML SSO for the flagship website, used internally and by multiple clients.
Migrated document storage from a distributed file system to blob storage with failover replication, serving all internal and client-uploaded documents.
Co-led an internal test dashboard that aggregated every software team’s test results in one place, with screenshots of failed UI tests and re-runs from the dashboard for any test runner.
work.summary: Platform Engineering team building shared infrastructure used by development teams across the company: authentication, document storage, permissions APIs and REST API templates.

awards.title: Gold Medal of Achievement (Eagle Scout)
awards.summary: Earned the Gold Medal of Achievement in Royal Rangers, a program that mirrors the Boy Scouts. The GMA has all the same requirements as the Eagle Scout Award.

projects.name: magic
projects.description: Open-source (MIT) skill kit for coding agents. Wrote its formal-verification skills, which route a task to model-checking, Hoare-logic or dependent-type tools, and tested checkers that stop an agent from weakening a locked specification or adding escape hatches such as sorry or assume to a proof.

projects.name: CPython proofs (in progress)
projects.description: Building a CBMC harness for CPython's C source, with line-coverage accounting and mutation tests that measure how strong each proof is. The first bounded proofs pass on unmodified source.

projects.name: Nand 2 Tetris
projects.description: Built a virtual 16-bit von Neumann computer from NAND logic gates.
